page_title: INT 3-1 BOL | Inter v Bologna 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

89' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
89' Yellow card. Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
88' Martin Vitik (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
87' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
85' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
85' The corner kick from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.

83' 3 - 1 Charalampos Lykogiannis takes the resulting free kick and sends the ball into the six-yard box, where Santiago Castro (Bologna) has an easy task to slot the ball into the back of the net. 3:1.
83' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Marcus Thuram and he is replaced by Matteo Lavelli (Inter).
82' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
79' Jens Odgaard goes off the pitch and Remo Freuler (Bologna) comes on.
78' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
75' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Augusto (Inter) replacing Alessandro Bastoni.
75' It is time for a substitution. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) is on for Lautaro Martinez.
74' 3 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Marcus Thuram (Inter) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the top right corner. He makes it 3:0.
74' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
72' Martin Vitik (Bologna) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
71' The attendance is 74710.
69' The corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is hurriedly cleared.
68' Emil Holm comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) coming on for Nicolo Cambiaghi.
67' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu will be replaced by Petar Sucic (Inter).
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is replacing Nicolo Barella.
63' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.

61' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia pulls off an easy save.
61' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
58' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece.
56' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) but poses no threat.
56' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

55' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Guida blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
53' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
53' Nicolo Barella (Inter) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
52' What a chance that is! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!

51' Manuel Akanji (Inter) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the right post!
48' 2 - 0 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. The score is 2:0.
48' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is about to take a corner kick.

48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Federico Ravaglia makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a half-time substitution. Martin Vitik (Bologna) comes on in place of Jhon Lucumi.
46' Half-time substitution. Nikola Moro will not participate anymore and Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Federico Ravaglia pulls off a great save to deny Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
42' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Piotr Zielinski (Inter) neatly controls a decent pass from Lautaro Martinez. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 1:0.
38' Flag up against Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
37' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Federico Dimarco (Inter) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
34' A long cross into the middle of the area is pounced on by Jens Odgaard (Bologna), but his header curls narrowly wide of the right post.
32' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
30' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Marco Guida and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

29' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Guida with no other option than to blow for a foul.
27' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Yann Sommer.
25' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
25' The referee awards a corner and Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take it.

24' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Federico Ravaglia sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top left corner.
24' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
22' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
21' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Good defending. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) tries to find Marcus Thuram inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
17' The game is interrupted. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

15' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Inter are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
12' Emil Holm (Bologna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.
12' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
9' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

9' Federico Ravaglia was forced into action to thwart Marcus Thuram (Inter). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.

6' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Federico Ravaglia blocks the shot with his legs.
6' Marcus Thuram (Inter) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
3' Looks like Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Guida blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Marco Guida will officiate today.
